description:
Replace a paginated thread's durable history with the prefix before one turn.

Without `expectedChangeIds`, only persisted conversation history changes.

beforeItemId.description: Optional user-message item inside `before_turn_id` to cut before instead of reverting the entire turn. When omitted, reverts immediately before `before_turn_id`.

beforeTurnId.description: Turn excluded from the replacement history, together with every later turn.

title: ThreadRevertParams
